hypothesis: Actual Linux execution uses the existing Git CLI branch-summary path to reduce measured first-comparison CPU; Windows native comparison, GUI code and existing helper placement remain unchanged.

candidate_identity.required_artifacts: Fresh static GNU Linux worker and matching Windows GUI with byte-verified embedding. No protocol2 helper, PE worker or Linux GUI is required for this primary experiment.

measurement: Unchanged canonical Open plus six actions, native Git/content/comment checks and two animation frames. Default renderer, same seeded profile and MCP. Completed welcome startup async error precedes measured Open. No helper preseed, cache flush or new tracing.
primary_metric: Worst end-to-end p95 across fresh-process Open and all six actions; report all opening and action first-use values separately. Fresh process is not OS-cold.
pilot_acceptance: Every launch, native correctness, scoring, fixture, identity and cleanup gate passes. An invalid run stops the series; no measurement retry within it.
Worst p95 across Open and all six actions improves by at least10% against the new interleaved A series.

At least one of fresh-process Open median or maximum p95 across branch_first, branch_final, stack and comment_branch improves by at least10%; an A1-only first-use drop does not establish a candidate gain.
Every final20 action p95 and maximum, plus fresh-process Open median, p95 and maximum, remains at most110% of matching new A. Keep every first-use sample and investigate failed guards.
Noisy or below-threshold evidence is inconclusive. This one-cell experiment cannot promote or complete the full four-cell and cold-cache campaign.
runtime_release: VM LINUX CLI BRANCH RUNTIME RELEASED
execution: Six serial fresh processes through one owned private mux/CDP tunnel; exact PID/create-time cleanup, free ports and native fixture/raw guards before and after. No concurrent builds or profiling.
ipc_diagnostic: Keep foreground intervals, overlapping background refresh, pending IPC and remainder. Backend evidence is not a GUI latency score.
preserved_controls: Same profile, repository, branch stack, comments, manifest, source/binary identities and two completion frames. No mixed helper-placement or staged-metadata candidate.
goal: Every cross-cell opening/action p95 below250ms, representative first/cold behavior and exact delivered builds; full campaign remains incomplete.
producer_gate: Require exact-root manifest Cargo compiler-artifact records for optimized GNU worker, its unit and stdio tests, and Windows GUI. All four must have fresh:false, exact target names/kinds/test flags and expected release executable paths; GUI features include custom-protocol. Copied worker/GUI producer paths must match these records, and actual native test names must equal the pinned25+1 names. Reused shared-cache root executables are invalid even when source hashes match.
